sourceCopy.name: Timeline Maker
sourceCopy.title: Timeline Maker Free | UsefulVerse
sourceCopy.description: Make an event timeline from dates and ranges. Sort events, zoom in, and download a free SVG or CSV locally.
sourceCopy.intro: Turn milestones or historical events into a clear, chronological timeline. Add a single date or a start and end date for each event.
sourceCopy.howQuestion: How do I make an event timeline?
sourceCopy.howAnswer: Add at least two named events and choose a start date for each. Add an end date for a duration or leave it blank for a single-day event. Create the timeline to sort events by date, adjust the zoom, and download SVG or CSV files.
sourceCopy.privacyAnswer: No. Names and dates are processed in this browser tab. The SVG and CSV are generated on your device; nothing is uploaded or saved automatically.
howTo: Enter a short name and start date for each event. Add an end date when it spans multiple days.
Add at least two events, then create the timeline. Events are sorted by start date; the original order is kept for dates that tie.
Adjust the chart zoom or download an SVG image or CSV table for your own use.

example.label: Example: a project launch and a multi-day milestone.

fields.pointHint: Leave the end date blank for a single-day event. Date ranges include both the start and end dates.
fields.scopeNote: This is an event timeline, not a task/dependency schedule or a source of historical facts. Enter dates you have checked.
fields.privacyNote: Your event names and dates stay in this tab. Nothing is uploaded or auto-saved. Exports are created locally.
fields.empty: Add at least two events to create a timeline.
fields.sourceNote: A timeline visualizes only the dates you enter. It does not verify event accuracy or infer missing dates.

messages.created: Timeline created and sorted by date.
messages.exampleLoaded: Example events loaded. Edit them or create the timeline.
messages.invalid: Check event names and dates. A range must end on or after its start.
messages.maximum: The timeline is limited to 80 events.
messages.exportUnavailable: Your browser could not create the download.

additionalFaqs.question: Can an event last more than one day?
additionalFaqs.answer: Yes. Enter both a start and end date. The chart includes both endpoint dates; leave the end blank for a single-day event.

additionalFaqs.question: Does this timeline create task dependencies?
additionalFaqs.answer: No. It shows dated events and ranges in chronological order. Use a project schedule tool for tasks, durations and dependencies.

additionalFaqs.question: Can I save or share the timeline?
additionalFaqs.answer: Download an SVG for a scalable image or a CSV for the event table. The page does not upload or automatically save your event data.
